label: Staking and liquidity incentives
summary: Plan reward funding, eligibility, accrual, claims and exits for token or liquidity-position incentives.
requiredFacts: Eligible deposit asset or LP position, custody model, lock, withdrawal and emergency-exit rules
Reward asset, funding source, emission schedule, duration, cap and undistributed-reward treatment
Accrual basis across deposits, withdrawals, transfers, liquidity changes and out-of-range positions
Who can fund, pause, recover, change emissions or migrate the program
Public distinction between projected rewards, funded rewards and evidence-backed realized returns
requiredTests: Deposit, accrue, claim, withdraw and emergency exit across boundary timestamps
Multiple users, changing balances, transferred positions and zero-liquidity intervals
Reward conservation, rounding dust, exhausted funding and undistributed rewards
Pause, migration, rescue and malicious reward-token behavior
No reward amplification through flash deposits, reentrancy or repeated claims
risks: Unfunded or mutable emissions can misrepresent achievable rewards
Custodied LP positions can expose principal to admin, migration or rescue authority
Snapshot or rounding errors can overpay strategic deposits
